subject: GPU ETA handshake & fallback proposal — ForgeAI dedicated onramp
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@forgeai.com>, Samir Patel <samir@zencompute.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@cloudzone.com>
Date: 2027-10-02 09:18 -07:00
Subject: GPU ETA handshake & fallback proposal — ForgeAI dedicated onramp

Hi all,

Quick summary: ForgeAI is targeting a dedicated onramp (200 vGPU-equivalent seats, burstable) for mid-November to support a Q4 feature launch. OEM lead times we've seen from vendors are volatile and cloud-backfill is the likely bridge — we need a clear, agreed handshake that ties vendor ETAs to a fallback plan and deposit/tranche mechanics so the sales/ops teams can commit dates to the customer.

What I need by COB Wed (Oct 6):
- ZenCompute: concrete earliest/likely/latest delivery windows for two tranches (50% / 50%) and any hard constraints (deposit %, shipping/ customs SLAs).
- CloudZone procurement: written capacity window we can rely on as a guaranteed fallback (dates + caps + pricing delta).
- Internal (Vanessa/Karthik/Ben): quick feasibility thumbs-up on hybrid staging (50% cloudburst first, OEM supply to follow) and confirmation on deposit approval limits.

Attached: forgeai_hardware_timeline_v3.xlsx (current proposed onramp milestones).

Proposed default plan (if all parties agree):
1) Stage A (cloud burst): Nov 15 start — 100 vGPU-equivalents on CloudZone for 8 weeks.
2) Stage B (OEM ship): staggered shipments to reach full 200 capacity by Dec 10 (if OEM can meet this).
3) Finance holdback: 30% deposit to secure OEM slots; Redwood issues bridging credits if OEM misses latest ETA beyond agreed slack.

Alicia — I want to be transparent on the fallback so ForgeAI has a deterministic onramp date even if some hardware slips.

Thanks,
Diego
Head of Supply & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---

From: Samir Patel <samir@zencompute.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia@forgeai.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03 10:42 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU ETA handshake & fallback proposal — ForgeAI dedicated onramp

Diego / Alicia / team,

Thanks for the note. Short version — we can support a two-tranche delivery but the manufacturing queue is tight right now. Our current timeline for the SKU quoted (ZC-TX8) is:
- Earliest partial ship (first tranche, ~50% units): Nov 18–Nov 25 (ships from MX factory, subject to customs + inland transit).
- Likely full delivery window for remaining units: Dec 6–Dec 16.
- Latest (if upstream component delay occurs): Jan 5.

Commercials/constraints:
- We require a 30% non-refundable deposit to secure production allocation and place you in a confirmed build slot.
- Staged shipments are supported (we can ship 50% first, remainder on the next manifest).
- We can add an express air option for the second tranche (+~18% on freight) to pull shipments earlier if needed.

I've attached the formal quote (zencompute_quote_210k_usd.pdf) and included line-item lead times. If Redwood can commit to deposit terms by Oct 8, we can lock the Nov 18 slot.

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through contingencies.

—Samir
Sales Director, ZenCompute

---

From: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudzone.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia@forgeai.com>
Date: 2027-10-04 08:09 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU ETA handshake & fallback proposal — ForgeAI dedicated onramp

Diego —

CloudZone can commit the following emergency/backfill capacity product for ForgeAI:
- Burst pool: 120 vGPU-equivalents available Nov 10–Feb 10 (90 day window).
- Guaranteed baseline: 80 vGPU-equivalents available immediately with 24‑hour provisioning SLA.
- Pricing: +22% on top of the standard dedicated rate for short-term burst; month-to-month commitment.

We will supply the official capacity statement and connectivity checklist — see attached (cloudzone_capacity_statement_Oct2027.pdf). Two operational notes:
1) Network egress and VPC peering needs to be provisioned in advance (we can start onboarding the VPC now — lead time ~3 business days).
2) If OEM shipments arrive earlier than the staged dates, we can scale down the burst without penalty within the first 30 days.

Let us know the preferred tranche sizes and targeted start date; we'll draft a short-term order that matches those windows.

—Procurement Team
CloudZone

---

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@zencompute.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@cloudzone.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia@forgeai.com>
Date: 2027-10-05 11:32 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU ETA handshake & fallback proposal — ForgeAI dedicated onramp

Appreciate the quick turn, Samir and CloudZone team. Proposed handshake (please confirm by COB Oct 6):

Plan A (preferred/hybrid):
- Nov 15: Provision 100 vGPU-equivalents on CloudZone (CloudZone burst).
- Nov 18: ZenCompute ships first tranche (50%); we reconcile receipts and scale CloudZone down to 50 within 7 days.
- Dec 10: Remaining ZenCompute shipment completes (target).
- Deposit & finance: Redwood to approve 30% deposit to ZenCompute by Oct 8 to lock Nov 18 slot. Ben — can you confirm limits?

Plan B (OEM-first fallback):
- If ZenCompute confirms only Dec earliest, we move full 150–200 capacity to CloudZone on Nov 15 and then step down as OEM arrives. Pricing delta applies.

Open questions for internal owners:
- Vanessa: Ops readiness for hybrid handoff and a 3‑day window to reconcile KV/cache warm-up during scale-down.
- Karthik: Any model-serving constraints we should flag for staged capacity (multi-model pinning / KV cache warmups)?
- Ben: Approve deposit up to 35% if required (we can offset via bridging credits).

Alicia — would this handshake meet ForgeAI’s launch constraints? If so we’ll proceed to secure deposit and issue short-term CloudZone order.

Thanks,
Diego

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@forgeai.com>, Samir Patel <samir@zencompute.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@cloudzone.com>
Date: 2027-10-06 14:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU ETA handshake & fallback proposal — ForgeAI dedicated onramp

Quick update from ops: we can execute the hybrid handoff. Notes:
- Ops can warm the KV cache during the first 72 hours; recommend a 48–72 hour overlap where both cloud and OEM capacity are live to avoid cold-start regressions.
- Network onboarding for CloudZone should start today — Karthik, please run the VPC checklist in the attached timeline and loop infra.
- Ben — please confirm deposit authorization threshold; if we need to exceed 30% to secure earlier shipping, we should approve up to 35% but flag Finance for credit offset.

Next steps I will action:
1) Kick CloudZone onboarding (start VPC peering).
2) Ben/Karthik align on finance/op constraints and confirm deposit by Oct 8.
3) I’ll update the timeline (attached: forgeai_hardware_timeline_v3.xlsx) and share a one‑pager for the customer.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference

[Attachments referenced: forgeai_hardware_timeline_v3.xlsx; zencompute_quote_210k_usd.pdf; cloudzone_capacity_statement_Oct2027.pdf]
